name: Nauru

fees.name: Visitor visa (up to 1 month)
fees.applies: all nationalities not eligible for free visa on arrival
fees.notes: Fee schedule on the Department of Justice & Border Control Immigration Division page lists $50; currency not explicitly stated on the page - Nauru's legal tender is the Australian dollar (AUD). Applications are made by email to Nauru Immigration; there is no e-visa portal.

fees.name: Visitor visa (up to 2 months)
fees.applies: all nationalities not eligible for free visa on arrival
fees.notes: Currency not explicitly stated on the page; assumed AUD (Nauru's legal tender).

fees.name: Visitor visa (up to 3 months)
fees.applies: all nationalities not eligible for free visa on arrival
fees.notes: Currency not explicitly stated on the page; assumed AUD (Nauru's legal tender).

fees.name: Free visa on arrival (eligible nationalities)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities: Cook Islands, Fiji, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Niue, Palau, Papua New Guinea, Russia, Samoa, Solomon Islands, Taiwan, Tonga, Tuvalu, Vanuatu
fees.notes: Eligibility list corroborated by multiple secondary sources; the official Immigration Division fee schedule does not list a visa-on-arrival class. Verify with Nauru Immigration before travel.

fees.name: Business visa - general (multiple entry, up to 12 months)
fees.notes: Plus $50 processing fee. Business visitors require a local sponsor. Currency not explicitly stated; assumed AUD.

fees.name: Business visa - media (single entry, up to 3 months)
fees.notes: AUD 8,000 media visa application fee is confirmed as AUD on naurugov.nr media fact sheet; non-refundable if application is unsuccessful.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: No transit visa class or fee is published on the official Immigration Division fee schedule; amount unverified.

reciprocity_variations.note: Russian citizens are among nationalities eligible for a free visa on arrival in Nauru (secondary sources; not on the official fee schedule page).

free_visa_notes: Nauru has no e-visa or eTA system; visas are arranged by emailing Nauru Immigration before travel. Citizens of 16 mostly Pacific states (plus Israel, Russia, Taiwan) receive a free visa on arrival. IND, USA, GBR, CHN, NGA, PAK, PHL, BGD and CAN nationals must obtain a visitor visa in advance ($50/$150/$250 for 1/2/3 months).
